conversation.Statement: Internal Revenue Service, Investigations Division. This is Agent Thomas Carter speaking. May I ask who I am speaking with?
Oh, hello, my name is Margaret Simmons. I got a message about my taxes and I'm very worried.
Yes, Mrs. Simmons, I see your case here. Our records indicate significant discrepancies on your recent federal tax filings. We need to discuss this immediately.
Discrepancies? But I thought everything was fine. I file my taxes every year.
Unfortunately, our audit department found that you failed to report certain income sources for the years 2018 through 2022. The IRS takes such omissions very seriously.
Oh my goodness. I live on my Social Security, I don't know what this is about. Am I in trouble?

Mrs. Simmons, at this stage, the IRS has issued an arrest warrant in your name for tax fraud and evasion. If we do not resolve this, local authorities will be dispatched to your address within the next two hours.
Arrest? No, no, there must be a mistake. Please, I can't go to jail. I'm 72 years old!
This is a legal matter, and if you do not comply, your Social Security benefits may also be suspended along with your driver's license. Do you understand the seriousness of this?
Yes, I do, but I can't lose my benefits. That's all I have.
Now, according to IRS protocol, you have one final opportunity to settle this balance outside of court. The outstanding amount, including late fees and penalties, is $3,950.
That's so much. I don't have that kind of money. Is there anything I can do?

If you act immediately, the IRS will allow an expedited payment method to stop the proceedings. I will provide you with secure payment instructions. You must not discuss this case with anyone until it is resolved.
Okay, I'll do what I can. How do I pay?

You will need to visit your nearest major pharmacy or retail store, such as CVS or Walgreens, and purchase Target or Apple gift cards totaling $3,950. This is the only method currently authorized for urgent settlements.
Gift cards? That doesn't sound like the IRS.
Ma'am, the IRS has designated this method due to immediate processing and COVID-19 protocols. If you fail to comply, I will have no option but to activate the arrest warrant and freeze your accounts.
Please, no! I'll go to the store now. What do I do after I buy them?
Once you have the cards, do not leave the store. Call me immediately and provide the codes on the back for verification and payment application. Do you understand?
Yes, I understand. I'll go as fast as I can. Can you wait on the line?
I will remain available. If you disconnect or delay, the system will process your warrant automatically. Proceed now.
Okay, I'm leaving right now. Please don't let anything happen to my benefits.
As long as you cooperate, your Social Security and assets will remain untouched. Remember, do not disclose this to anyone at the store, as this is a federally protected case.
